🇦🇺 🇵🇭 🇺🇸 🇳🇿 As part of Exercise Balikatan 2026, soldiers from Australia, the United States, the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and New Zealand engaged targets with small arms, general machine guns, and 84mm recoilless rifles during a counter‑landing live‑fire activity in the Philippines.

Exercise Balikatan 2026 (BK26) is an annual training exercise conducted between the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and United States military designed to enhance military cooperation and readiness.

#YourADF #AusArmy #StrongerTogether
